author: nickyeow

english.text: Korean food is noted for its spicy flavor.

author: nickyeow

english.text: Busy with my work, I had no time to write to you.

jyutping: ngo5 zou6 je5 hou2 mong4，so2 ji5 mou5 si4 gaan1 se2 seon3 bei2 nei5。

english.text: Those who are knowledgeable generally recognize how ignorant they really are.

author: thesilhouette

english.text: When Tom was working on the dairy farm, he had to get up at five o'clock every morning to go and milk the cows.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 hai2 muk6 coeng4 zou6 je5 go2 zan6，mui5 ziu1 jiu3 ng5 dim2 zung1 hei2 san1 zaa1 ngau4 naai5。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: You could at least try.

jyutping: nei5 si3 haa5 dou1 dak1 gwaa3。

english.text: The people in M.C. Escher's lithograph, "Ascending and Descending", seem to climb up and up a set of stairs, but keep returning to the same level where they started. This is an optical illusion. Could there be a similar musical illusion? Could someone design a musical scale that always seems to be going up in pitch but also goes all the way around to the beginning? Someone could, and did.

jyutping: hai2 M.C. ge3 jan4。 aai1 se3 ji5 ge3 sek6 baan2 waa2「soeng6 sing1 tung4 haa6 gong3」，hou2 ci5 hai6 paa4 soeng5 tung4 soeng6 jat1 tou3 lau4 tai1，daan6 hai6 bat1 dyun6 faan1 heoi3 keoi5 dei6 hoi1 ci2 ge3 tung4 jat1 cang4 ci3。 ni1 go3 hai6 gwong1 hok6 co3 gok3。 wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 leoi6 ci5 ge3 jam1 ngok6 co3 gok3？ jau5 mou5 jan4 ho2 ji5 cit3 gai3 jat1 go3 jam1 gaai1，ling6 dou3 jam1 gou1 zung2 hai6 wui2 soeng6 sing1，daan6 hai6 jau6 wui5 jat1 zik6 heoi3 dou3 hoi1 tau4？ jau5 jan4 ho2 ji5，ji4 ce2 zou6 dou3。
text: 喺 M.C. 嘅人。 埃舍爾嘅石版畫「上升同下降」，好似係爬上同上一套樓梯，但係不斷返去佢哋開始嘅同一層次。 呢個係光學錯覺。 會唔會有類似嘅音樂錯覺？ 有冇人可以設計一個音階，令到音高總係會上升，但係又會一直去到開頭？ 有人可以，而且做到。
